title: Model Launch Orchestration Playbook: catalog, benchmarks, docs, and GTM
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and execute a repeatable, cross-functional playbook to onboard a newly vetted model into the Redwood Catalog and to coordinate benchmarks, docs, and GTM communications. This ticket covers orchestration steps, owners, deliverables, and timing for a safe canary-to-GA rollout. Goal: make the model available in Hosted API, update catalog metadata, publish benchmark/latency/cost guidance, and launch marketing collateral with clear operational guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry created and approved with metadata, tags, and compatible variants
Benchmark report published (latency, throughput, token-cost) and referenced from catalog
Docs pages (API examples, migration notes, best-practices) live in docs site
Release notes draft approved by PM, Eng, and Legal and scheduled for publication
Canary rollout executed for 10% traffic for 48 hours with no critical incidents
GA rollout completed and marketing assets published per launch schedule

Benchmarks: run p95 latency, throughput, and cost-per-1k-token on hosted and dedicated variants - owner: Eng (Rosa) - deliverable: benchmarks CSV + summary
Quantization note: capture recommended quantization settings and trade-offs - owner: Research (Hiroshi)
Docs: write 'Getting started' example (Python + cURL), structured output examples, and migration notes for older model IDs - owner: Docs (Maya)

Release notes: assemble highlights, breaking changes (if any), and 'when to use' guidance - owner: PM (Liam)

Sales enablement: create one-pager and FAQ for solutions engineers - owner: GTM (Marcus)
Support: update internal KB and create canned responses for common customer questions - owner: Support (Priya)

stakeholders: Engineering: Rosa Kim, Diego Alvarez, Kavya Sharma
rollout_strategy: Canary -> graduated GA. Start at 5-10% traffic for minimum 48h with automated health checks. If p99 latency increase <20% and error rate within baseline and no customer-facing regressions, increase to 50% for 24h then 100% GA. Pre-defined rollback triggers: error spike >2x baseline, latency p95 regression >40%, or customer incidents flagged by Support.
release_notes_outline: Headline: New model added to Redwood Catalog: [ModelName]
TL;DR: notable improvements, best-fit use cases
API changes: new params or structured-output behavior
Migration notes: recommended fallbacks and equivalence mapping
docs_requirements: Overview doc with model intent and recommended prompts
API quickstart with Python and cURL snippets, including streaming and function-calling examples
Best-practices section: temperature/penalty guidance and batching recommendations
Compatibility matrix: supported runtimes, quantization profiles, and maximum context length
Changelog entry and migration guide for deprecated models
benchmark_requirements: Latency: p50/p95/p99 across tested sequence lengths (16, 128, 512, 2048)
Throughput: tokens/sec under continuous batching for typical payloads
Cost: estimated $/1k tokens at recommended runtime profiles
Quality: evaluation on small benchmark set (summarization, code, instruction following) with examples
Environment: hardware, GPU type, driver and runtime versions recorded
marketing_assets: Blog post draft and hero image
Demo notebook for customers showing best-case prompts and performance
Sample pricing blurb and recommended routing guidance for cost-sensitive tiers
internal_comm_plan: Pre-brief with Sales, Support, and Solutions on launch day - 24h before GA
Slack announcement to #product-updates and #release-notes at GA time
Internal playbook with runbook links sent to on-call and support
Weekly sync for 2 weeks post-launch to review signals and customer feedback
monitoring_and_slo: Instrument model-specific routes: response time, error rate, token cost per request
Create dashboards for p50/p95/p99 latency and tail errors
Alert thresholds: error rate >1% absolute increase or p95 latency +30%
SLO target: 99.5% availability for cataloged model endpoints in hosted tier
post_launch_tasks: Signal review at 48h and 2 weeks with decision log
Ingest customer usage into cost model and update recommended config guidance
Collect top 10 user prompts and surface to Research for potential tuning
Finalize marketing recap and case studies for notable early adopters
